skill_name: Identify and describe the cultural aspects of Japan.
workflow: Japan is a country with a unique and dynamic culture that has evolved over thousands of years. Some of the distinctive aspects of the Japanese culture include a deep respect for tradition, emphasis on honor, high level of respect for elders and family, extreme attention to detail, and strong emphasis on self-discipline.
